_comment: Fixture for the vendor demo (/vendor/demo). Served statically from GitHub Pages so the demo is deterministic, offline and cannot touch real pools. Shape mirrors GET /widget/config and GET /widget/pools exactly — if those change, change this too.
_pools_note: Each pool names something the demo storefront actually sells, and its target is the number of units that clears the €75 free-shipping threshold at that product's price: wool socks €18.50 → 5 units (€92.50, so 3 claimed = €55.50 is one pair short); cushion covers €45.00 → 2 (€90.00); wool scarves €39.95 → 2 (€79.90). The widget only shows counts, so the arithmetic is not on screen — but a pool for a product the shop does not sell is exactly the sort of thing a merchant notices.
